{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Interstellar Starshipwright's Guild Book of Specifications and Classifications''''' was a book published by the [[Interstellar Starshipwright's Guild]] that contained descriptions of various [[Starship/Legends|spaceworthy vessels]] and divided them into categories. Among the ship types described in the book was the [[M-class|''M''-class ship]].
